$comment: Benchmark target list — ANONYMIZED (tracked). The four vibe-coding targets are labelled target-1..target-4; their real repo URLs, notes and provenance live in benchmark/repos.local.json (gitignored, available on request). run.mjs reads repos.local.json when it exists and falls back to this file, so a fresh checkout runs the anonymized list and the author's machine runs the real one. Commit SHAs are NEVER stored in either file: benchmark/run.mjs records the resolved commit (git rev-parse HEAD) into results/<name>/meta.json at run time. realworld-control stays NAMED (not anonymized) because it is already public via examples/realworld-assessment — the control must be independently reproducible, and naming it leaks nothing that is not already in the repo. SAMPLING LIMITATION, stated up front: two of the four anonymized targets are by the same author and share a Next.js house style, and three of four are TypeScript. This is a small, convenience sample, not a representative one. The mapping real-name -> label is defined ONCE in benchmark/anonymize-results.mjs (LABEL_MAP).
